scope: Implement and fast-validate version-specific FIELD DXF wire behavior supported by the available AutoCAD observations, preserving fail-closed converter export.

changes: AC1018-and-earlier FIELD values use legacy group 4 root format and do not emit the R2007+ ACVALUE_END delimiter.
Legacy main CadValue scalar payloads can now pass writer preflight when representable by the old value grammar.
Modern FIELD output omits group 4; a compatible root format is copied into the modern nested CadValue format group 300.
Conflicting root and nested format strings are rejected transactionally.
Pre-R2007 writes reject nested CadValue format/value strings that the target grammar cannot represent.
Generated tests cover exact ASCII and binary tags for legacy and modern profiles, modern nested 300/302 and duplicate root cache, legacy delimiter omission, format promotion, and failure rollback.
Parser controls verify modern nested format/value and legacy group-4 plus typed double/root cached text through ASCII and binary routes, with following-record sentinels.
unqualified: strings exceeding 255 bytes and any overflow chunking policy
producer-saved file with exact AutoCAD build and DXF save/reopen provenance
complete emitted FIELD/FIELDLIST graph closure and TABLE group-344 export
